This is gonna sound strange, I know, but a sophisticated selfie may one day keep you from getting locked out of your Google account.

➜ Google’s added in the ability to verify your identity and recover your account by simply staring into the camera on your phone and turning your head a few times.

☝️ This notably is not the same as biometric authentication on your phone itself. It’s connected to your underlying Google account — the one that’s responsible for storing all the info about your Android apps and settings along with any data associated with Gmail, Photos, Maps, Docs and Drive, and every other Google service — which makes it one of the most important and consequential accounts you own.

⌚ And two minutes of simple setup today could save you from a lifetime of regret down the road, if you were ever to lose access for any reason.

In my experience so far, it seems most Android-owning animals are woefully unaware of this option’s existence — and those who are aware of it are mostly perplexed by how it works and if it’s advisable to use.

📌 So I put together a primer with everything you need to know about the new selfie sign-in system and how you can get it up and running.

I’d strongly suggest taking the time now to think it over — before the need ever arises.

The official AI Platinum app is what’s known as a progressive web app, which means it works on practically any device and operating system without the need for any proprietary standards or platform-specific storefronts. It relies on your browser to operate but but looks and acts like any other regular standalone app on your phone — or even on your computer.

Here’s all you’ve gotta do to install it:

On Android

  1. Open the Platinum Community forum site in Chrome on your phone. (The same basic process will apply in Edge and certain other browsers. Firefox, unfortunately, doesn’t currently support these types of cross-platform apps.)
  2. Tap the three-dot menu icon in the browser’s upper-right corner.
  3. Tap the “Install app” line in the Chrome menu.
  4. Tap the word “Install” on the pop-up that comes up.

And that’s it: All that’s left is to look on your home screen or in your app drawer to find your fancy new AI Platinum icon!

You can even then share stuff like links from your web browser directly into the Platinum Community app to post ’em into the forum, too.

How awesome is that?!

On your desktop computer

  1. Again, open the Platinum Community site in Chrome. (And again, the same basic process will apply in Edge and certain other browsers but not in Firefox, as it’s unfortunately opted against supporting PWAs at all.)
  2. Click the three-dot menu icon in the browser’s upper-right corner.
  3. Look for the line labeled “Install Android Intelligence Platinum Community” in the menu that comes up, and — oh yes, you guessed it — click it!
  4. Click “Install” in the confirmation box that comes up.

And then celebrate your newfound awesomeness by clicking the icon on your desktop, shrieking with glee, and drinking the most expensive bottle of tangerine fizzy-water you can get your greasy hands on.

Questions? Problems? Fizzy-water recommendations? Head over to the Help Desk for a friendly helping hand (and/or mouth, for drinking).

When you subscribe to the Android Intelligence Platinum podcast, you gain access to all sorts of productivity-boosting resources beyond just the weekly audio show. Here’s what’ll be at your fingertips:

The Platinum Power-Up: A subject-specific guidebook prepared exclusively for Platinum members every other Monday. Whether you’re a power user or a mobile-tech novice, you’re guaranteed to learn tons of useful stuff.

The Platinum Edition Newsletter: A supercharged, customizable, and ad-free version of the weekly newsletter featuring deep reads, quick hits, and answers to reader submitted questions every Friday.

Android Intelligence Interactive: A members-only forum with direct access to yours truly. I’m never out of reach — and I’m always available to answer questions and provide personalized recommendations and tech advice. (Or you can just peek in on what other people are asking!)

The Complete Tips Collection: All of the practical knowledge from both the newsletter and the Power-Up, collected and kept up-to-date in a single searchable database for your productivity-boosting pleasure.

Platinum Resource Sheets: Supremely detailed guides to some of the most sought-after subjects within the Android, Chrome, and greater Google world — things like optimizing your Google storage, setting yourself up for better Android battery life, and taking your music into your own hands.

My Essential Android Apps: A regularly updated list of recommendations showcasing my most important apps and how they fit into my workflow (and non-work flow, too!).

My Essential Chrome Extensions: A detailed and always evolving guide to the extensions and add-ons that turn Chrome into my optimal work environment — whether on a Chrome OS device or in the regular Chrome browser.

How I Use Android: A breakdown of the current devices and accessories I find indispensable in my own day-to-day life — plus an up-close look at how my home screen is optimized for efficiency.

How I Use Chrome OS: A dynamic tour of the devices, accessories, and setups I personally use to stay productive on a Chromebook and Chromebox.

The Platinum Publication Archive: Every Platinum Edition newsletter and Power-Up ever published, at your fingertips. Browse entire issues at your leisure and download anything you want on demand for easy offline reading.

The Platinum Wallpaper Collection: An exclusive series of Android Intelligence wallpapers along with handpicked minimalist favorites to give your phone or desktop a striking new look.

The Platinum Discount Store: Access to a special version of the Android Intelligence Store with a permanent 20% discount on all current and future Android Intelligence merchandise.

And More: The Platinum membership program is always expanding — and it’s your community, so I’m always on the lookout for suggestions on what you want to see. Expect new perks and benefits to appear periodically over time.
